production_baseline.note: Wave 8 production after schema fix. Missed all three tiers.

eou_drift.explanation: LiveKit dynamic endpointing interpolates toward SAM_ENDPOINTING_MAX. Production max was 1.2s; 0.78s is a mid-confidence blend. Embedded 8-turn sessions stayed at min_delay. Capping max at 0.6s prevents the 777ms floor.

barge_in_instrument.old_t0: time.perf_counter() before publish_fixture, including leading silence and 100ms pause-monitor lag
barge_in_instrument.new_t0: first voiced interrupt frame minus AUDIO_PAUSED_LAG_S (100ms)
barge_in_instrument.conclusion: Most of the 1081ms Premium miss was harness error, not agent interruption delay.

endpointing_matrix.note: VAD barge-in 2.6ms is treated as a measurement floor, not a ship number. STT 0.25/0.6 is the evidence-backed default.

groq_llama_3_1_8b_instant.disqualified: 6K TPM exhausts the canon prompt in 1-2 LLM turns

groq_llama_3_3_70b_versatile.disqualified: 12K TPM still 429s mid-session; tool-loop also hit max function-call steps

brain_bakeoff.reason: Identical grounded/intent scores because the expanded router covers those fixtures. Groq is faster on TTFT but not production-safe on current TPM. Hybrid is the router itself: tool turns bypass the LLM.

tier.note: Barge-in <250ms. Full-matrix v2v misses Minimum Enterprise because long/LLM turns stay at gpt-4o-mini TTFT (~500-600ms) plus transport. Groq is faster but unsafe at 6K/12K TPM.

pre_cap_run.note: Render still had SAM_ENDPOINTING_MAX=1.2 until the code-side cap shipped.
